title: Case: Customer asks for an explanation of a carrier-issued import charge
context: The carrier issued an import charge that the recipient does not understand. Billing must explain the lines; the desk cannot waive them or invent tax rules.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-047: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 43 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
